problem_evidence.interpretation: V61 cannot distinguish model capacity from an incomplete LeftBrain-to-RightBrain payload. The next experiment must isolate the missing speech plan while holding the model fixed.

scientific_basis.claim: Natural-language generation separates content planning from surface realization, so the surface realizer should receive an explicit representation of what must be said.
Explicit content guidance can improve generation quality and coherence compared with unguided surface generation.
Dialogue generation should preserve dialogue acts and semantic attributes while varying the surface wording.

priority_selection.scale: Preregistration-time ordinal scores from 1 to 5; this ranking is not an empirical project score.
priority_selection.selection_reason: It tests the exact V61 integration failure with one changed variable before spending effort on a new contract architecture or another model comparison.

causal_hypothesis: Given the same fresh user input, isolated memory view, psyche, route, cognitive_tick logic, Qwen3.5 9B model, system prompt, generation settings, and scoring, attaching the runtime-built human_speech_plan before payload construction will improve independent required-meaning recall without increasing forbidden meaning, private-memory leakage, surface faults, or local latency beyond the frozen limits.
causal_boundary: This pilot estimates only the effect of including the runtime human_speech_plan in one-pass RightBrain model input. It does not estimate LeftBrain quality, generic semantic-contract quality, whole-chat naturalness, personality fidelity, memory learning, reflection, or broad human likeness.

c0_tick_logic_payload.description: Build the model payload from the frozen cognitive_tick logic before human_speech_plan is attached.

t1_full_speech_plan_payload.description: Build and attach one runtime human_speech_plan, then construct the otherwise identical model payload.

fixed_variables: same cognitive_tick logic before the treatment attachment
same user input and isolated memory fixture
same scoring-only required and forbidden propositions
one transport attempt and no repair model call
stop_conditions: Stop before inference if the tree is dirty, any frozen hash drifts, freshness fails, or production memory isolation fails.
Stop before the first RightBrain call unless all 14 treatment payloads contain a nonempty human_speech_plan copied from the one shared per-case runtime plan.
Stop the hypothesis if any automatic advance gate fails; do not expand the sample, request human ratings, or integrate runtime behavior.
Do not rerun consumed V62 cases, edit propositions, retry a model call, or change thresholds after inference.
If adding the speech plan fails, investigate a different semantic representation instead of adding prompt patches.

decision_rule.automatic_pass: Freeze the result and authorize only a separate generic semantic-contract projector development PR on new data.
decision_rule.automatic_fail: Freeze the negative result, keep production unchanged, and stop the full-speech-plan payload hypothesis.
decision_rule.production_change: Never authorized directly by this pilot.
